**Welcome to Azadi Oriental Tandoor Restaurant (halal) in Innsbruck!**

Discover the vibrant flavors of the East in the heart of **Tirol**. Our authentic **Tandoor** cuisine brings you a taste of tradition, crafted with care in our wood-fired ovens. From succulent **Tandoor Chicken** and tender **Lamb Chops** to fragrant **Biryani** and crispy **Naan**, every dish is a journey to the spices and aromas of the Orient.

Experience the warmth of **Tirol** with a touch of the exotic—where every meal is a celebration of culture and taste. Whether you're craving a hearty **Shawarma** or a delicate **Kebabs**, our menu offers something for every palate.

**Halal-certified** and family-friendly, Azadi is your go-to spot for a memorable dining experience in **Innsbruck**. Come taste the magic of the East—right here in the Alps!
